parrafo.es: Miami Muscle Movers mueve casas, muebles pesados y oficinas en Kendall y todo Miami-Dade. Trabajo real respaldado por la calificación de 4.9 en Google que dejaron nuestros clientes.
parrafo.en: Miami Muscle Movers handles homes, heavy furniture and office moves across Kendall and all of Miami-Dade. Real work backed by the 4.9 rating our customers left on Google.

hero.imagen_alt: Miami Muscle Movers crew member carrying a wrapped upholstered headboard during a Miami move

parrafo_1.es: Derek y su equipo mueven casas, muebles pesados y oficinas en Kendall y en todo Miami, envolviendo y cargando cada pieza como si fuera propia. De un sofá de tres plazas a una bañera de 550 libras, el mismo cuidado en cada mudanza.
parrafo_1.en: Derek and his crew move homes, heavy furniture and offices across Kendall and all of Miami, wrapping and carrying every piece like it is their own. From a three seat sofa to a 550 pound bathtub, the same care goes into every move.

parrafo_2.es: Clientes que han repetido con el equipo varias veces en los últimos años lo dicen en Google: precios justos, un proceso de cobro claro y un trabajo terminado sin sorpresas.
parrafo_2.en: Clients who have used the crew more than once over the past few years say it on Google: fair prices, a clear billing process and a finished job with no surprises.

texto.es: Llámanos y cuéntanos qué necesitas mover: una casa completa, una pieza pesada o una oficina. Respondemos directo al +1 (305) 972-5654.
texto.en: Call us and tell us what you need moved: a full home, one heavy piece or an office. We answer directly at +1 (305) 972-5654.

texto.es: Te damos una idea del alcance y el costo antes de que el equipo llegue a tu puerta.
texto.en: We give you an idea of the scope and the cost before the crew shows up at your door.

texto.es: Envolvemos cada mueble y objeto frágil antes de cargarlo, para que llegue a su destino tal como salió.
texto.en: We wrap every piece of furniture and fragile item before loading it, so it arrives the way it left.

texto.es: Cargamos, transportamos y colocamos todo en su lugar, local o en otro estado, sin dejarte con cajas a medias.
texto.en: We load, transport and place everything where it belongs, local or out of state, without leaving you with half packed boxes.

nota.es: Cada mudanza se cotiza según el volumen, la distancia y el acceso. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every move is quoted based on volume, distance and access. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Sofás, muebles de madera maciza, bañeras y piezas de varios cientos de libras, cargadas y aseguradas con cuidado.
texto.en: Sofas, solid wood furniture, bathtubs and pieces that weigh hundreds of pounds, carried and secured with care.

texto.es: Mudanzas fuera de la Florida, desde Tampa hasta Carolina del Norte, con el mismo equipo durante todo el trayecto.
texto.en: Moves outside Florida, from Tampa to North Carolina, with the same crew handling the job start to finish.

texto.es: Mudanzas de apartamentos y casas dentro de Kendall y Miami, con el mismo equipo de principio a fin.
texto.en: Apartment and home moves within Kendall and Miami, with the same crew from start to finish.

texto.es: Desmontaje, empaque y traslado de muebles y equipo de oficina, fuera de horario si lo necesitas.
texto.en: Disassembly, packing and transport of office furniture and equipment, after hours if you need it.

pie.es: ¿Tu mudanza incluye algo fuera de lo común, como una pieza muy pesada? Pregúntanos igual, seguro podemos con ella.
pie.en: Does your move involve something unusual, like an oversized piece? Ask us anyway, chances are we can handle it.

items.quote: Muscle movers are fantastic. They walked me through the moving process step by step. Their billing process was very clear, accurate and reasonable! The moving men were very helpful and courteous. I highly recommend this company for all your moving needs!

We've used Derek and his team 3 times in the past 4 years, for local Miami moves. Amazing young men, professional, courteous, respectful of our stuff, and super pleasant and fun to talk to. Fair prices too, the only movers in the area I'll be using.

Miami Muscle Movers is an amazing company. Derek and his team did a fantastic job with our move to North Carolina. They were affordable and completed the job in a timely fashion. I would definitely give them a 5-star review for their excellent service!
